description: LastDatabase helps users search B2B contact data, access entitled contact records, verify email addresses, and check remaining account records directly from ChatGPT. Search results can be filtered by criteria such as country, industry, company, and job title. Sensitive contact information remains protected until the authenticated user has the required entitlement. Existing LastDatabase customers can sign in with their account to access the features and records included in their account.

defaultPrompt: Search for 5 B2B contacts in the technology industry in the USA. Do not unlock any contacts.
Tell me how many LastDatabase records I have remaining. Do not search for or unlock any contacts.
Verify test@example.com and show me the verification result.
